AllowPartialBuy.description_en:
Indicates whether on-demand authorization purchase is allowed during initial purchase. Valid values:
0: Not allowed.
1: Allowed
AllowPartialBuy.description_zh:
新购时是否允许按需购买授权，取值：
0：不允许
1：允许

AllowUpgradePartialBuy.description_en:
Indicates whether upgrading to on-demand authorization purchase is allowed during an upgrade. Valid values:
0: Not allowed.
1: Allowed
AllowUpgradePartialBuy.description_zh:
升级时时是否允许升级到按需购买授权，取值：
0：不允许
1：允许

AllowUserUnbind.description_en:
Indicates whether immediate unbinding of all bound assets is allowed. Valid values:
0: No.
1: Yes
AllowUserUnbind.description_zh:
是否允许立即解绑所有已绑定资产，取值：
0：否
1：是

AutoBind.description_en:
Indicates whether new subscription assets are automatically bound when the host and container security subscription service is activated. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
AutoBind.description_zh:
开通主机及容器安全包年包月服务时，表示包年包月新增资产自动绑定。取值：

0：关闭
1：开启

ClusterNodeCheck.description_en:
Indicates whether cluster nodes require agent version verification. Valid values:
0: Not required.
1: Required
ClusterNodeCheck.description_zh:
集群节点是否需要检校验机器版本，取值：
0：不需要
1：需要

DefaultAuthToAll.description_en:
Indicates whether all assets are authorized by default. Valid values:
0: No.
1: Yes
DefaultAuthToAll.description_zh:
是否对所有资产默认授权，取值
0：否
1：是

HasPreBindSetting.description_en:
Indicates whether a pre-bindingasset configuration exists. Pre-binding refers to the asset binding configuration selected in advance during purchase. Valid values:
0: Does not exist.
1: Exists
HasPreBindSetting.description_zh:
是否存在预绑定资产配置，预绑定是指在购买时提前选择的资产绑定配置，取值：
0：不存在
1：存在

HighestVersion.description_en:
The highest purchased edition of Security Center. Valid values:
1: Free Edition.
3: Enterprise Edition.
5: Premium Edition.
6: Anti-virus Edition.
7: Ultimate Edition.
10: Value-added services only.
If a single edition is purchased, this value indicates the corresponding edition. If multiple editions are purchased, this value indicates the highest sub-edition
HighestVersion.description_zh:
购买安全中心最高版本。取值：
1：免费版
3：企业版
5：高级版
6：防病毒版
7：旗舰版
10：仅采购增值服务
购买是单版本则表示对应的版本，购买为多版本时，该值表示子版本的最高版本

InvalidBindStatus.description_en:
The binding validity status. Valid values:
NORMAL: Valid.
INVALID_NODE_VERSION: Invalid
InvalidBindStatus.description_zh:
绑定生效状态，取值：
NORMAL：有效
INVALID_NODE_VERSION：无效

IsMultiVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether multiple versions exist. Valid values:
0: No.
1: Yes
IsMultiVersion.description_zh:
是否多版本，取值：
0：不存在
1：存在

BindCoreCount.description_en: The number of cores of assets that are bound with authorization
BindCoreCount.description_zh: 已绑定授权的资产核数

PostPaidBindCoreCount.description_en: The number of cores of assets bound with pay-as-you-go authorization
PostPaidBindCoreCount.description_zh: 绑定后付费授权的资产核数

PostPaidBindEcsCount.description_en: The number of assets bound with pay-as-you-go authorization
PostPaidBindEcsCount.description_zh: 绑定后付费授权的资产台数

RiskCoreCount.description_en: The number of cores of assets that have security risks
RiskCoreCount.description_zh: 存在安全风险的资产核数

RiskEcsCount.description_en: The number of assets that have security risks
RiskEcsCount.description_zh: 存在安全风险的资产台数

TotalCoreCount.description_en: The total number of asset cores

UnBindCoreCount.description_en: The number of cores of unbound assets

PostPaidHighestVersion.description_en:
The protection edition of the host and container security pay-as-you-go service. This is the highest protection edition among all bound hosts. Valid values:  
1: Free Edition. 
3: Enterprise Edition.
5: Premium Edition.
6: Anti-virus Edition.    
7: Ultimate Edition
PostPaidHighestVersion.description_zh:
开通主机及容器安全按量付费服务的防护版本，为所有已绑定主机中的最高防护版本。 取值：  
1：免费版 
3：企业版
5：高级版
6：防病毒版    
7：旗舰版

PostPaidHostAutoBind.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic binding of new hosts is enabled for the host and container security pay-as-you-go service. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
PostPaidHostAutoBind.description_zh:
主机及容器安全按量付费服务新增主机自动绑定标识，取值：
0：关闭
1：开启

PostPaidHostAutoBindVersion.description_en:
The edition to which new assets are automatically bound for the host and container security pay-as-you-go service. Valid values:
1: Free Edition. 
3: Enterprise Edition.
5: Premium Edition.
6: Anti-virus Edition.    
7: Ultimate Edition
PostPaidHostAutoBindVersion.description_zh:
主机及容器安全按量付费服务新增资产自动绑定版本，取值：
1：免费版 
3：企业版
5：高级版
6：防病毒版    
7：旗舰版

PostPaidVersionSummary.description_en: The service authorization statistics for the host and container security pay-as-you-go service
PostPaidVersionSummary.description_zh: 主机及容器安全按量付费服务授权统计

AuthBindType.description_en:
The type of authorization consumed during binding. Valid values:
ASSET: consumes authorized asset count.
CORE: consumes authorized core count.
ASSET_AND_CORE: consumes both authorized asset count and authorized core count
AuthBindType.description_zh:
绑定时消耗的授权类型，取值：
ASSET：消耗授权台数
CORE：消耗授权核数
ASSET_AND_CORE：同时消耗授权台数和授权核数

Index.description_en:
The index of the current edition. A larger value indicates a higher edition. This field is used for sorting. Valid values:
1: Free Edition. 
2: Anti-virus Edition.    
3: Premium Edition.
4: Enterprise Edition.
5: Ultimate Edition
Index.description_zh:
当前版本索引，数值越大版本越高，用于排序，取值：
1：免费版 
2：防病毒版    
3：高级版
4：企业版
5：旗舰版

UsedCoreCount.description_en:
The number of authorized cores that have been used.
This parameter is valid only when AuthBindType is set to CORE or ASSET_AND_CORE
UsedCoreCount.description_zh:
已使用的授权核数。
此参数在AuthBindType取值为CORE或ASSET_AND_CORE时有效

UsedEcsCount.description_en:
The number of authorized assets that have been used.
This parameter is valid only when AuthBindType is set to ASSET or ASSET_AND_CORE
UsedEcsCount.description_zh:
已使用的授权台数。
此参数在AuthBindType取值为ASSET或ASSET_AND_CORE时有效

Version.description_en:

5: Premium Edition.
